title: thelypteris subpubescens
intro: Thelypteris subpubescens, commonly known as the pubescent maiden fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its feathery fronds and ability to photosynthesize. The health benefits of Thelypteris subpubescens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, and its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
